verdict.rationale: Poly documents folder view modes, including a table layout remembered per folder, plus tags and natural-language search. None of these is a structured-property query that renders a live database-style view: the view modes show folder contents, and search is semantic rather than property-based. This is adjacent functionality, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can query my notes by their structured properties and render live database-style views (tables, boards, lists) from those queries
